Class Game

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am43.model.board.Game
All Implemented Interfaces:
ModelInterface, Serializable
public class Game extends Object implements ModelInterface, Serializable
Core model class representing the state and game logic of a single match. Tracks connected players, current phases, turn management, and board interaction handlers.

  • Constructor Details

    • Game

      public Game(int np, String nk, Color color)
      Initializes a new Game with a randomly generated internal seed. Sets the state to PREPARATION and registers the founding player.
      Parameters:
      np - the expected number of players for this match
      nk - the nickname chosen by the initial player
      color - the color chosen by the initial player

    • Game

      public Game(int np, String nk, Color color, Long seed)
      Initializes a new Game context with a pregenerated seed. Sets the state to PREPARATION and registers the founding player.
      Parameters:
      np - the expected number of players for this match
      nk - the nickname chosen by the initial player
      color - the color chosen by the initial player
      seed - the given seed utilized to reproduce deterministic outcomes

    • moveToInactive

      public void moveToInactive(Player player) throws IllegalArgumentException
      Puts the player in the INACTIVE state and, if it was their turn, advances the phase. If only one active player remains, it notifies single-player mode.
      Specified by:
      moveToInactive in interface ModelInterface
      Parameters:
      player - the player to make inactive
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException

    • pickCard

      public void pickCard(Card card, Player player)
      The current player picks a card from the board. Checks turn, phase, available actions and the card's position. Delegates the pickup effect to the card itself via Card.pick(GameObserver, Player).
      Specified by:
      pickCard in interface ModelInterface
      Parameters:

      player - the player picking it
